name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
title: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd - 533088 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Holiday-club operator: standalone Q4 EBITDA margin 34.9% (+180bp) and resort utilisation ~81%, but a INR234 crore standalone impairment on Finland/HCRO and weak member-acquisition cash flow temper the read.

utilisation.quote: we are able to showcase that utilization we are able to manage at 80.7% or 81%

capex.quote: we are looking to build on this and we expect more than 1,000 keys to be added in F '27

triggers.label: Utilisation ~81% in Q4
triggers.quote: we are able to showcase that utilization we are able to manage at 80.7% or 81%

triggers.label: New-sale AUR up ~30%
triggers.quote: new sales AUR has jumped up roughly 30%

triggers.label: Keys added ~900 in FY26; 1,000+ in FY27
triggers.quote: we expect more than 1,000 keys to be added in F '27

triggers.label: INR234 cr impairment on Finland book
triggers.quote: We took an impairment in our stand-alone books of about INR234 crores. This is obviously a one-off.

triggers.label: Membership flat ~304,000
triggers.quote: Our overall membership base is roughly constant at about 304,000.

guidance.quote: we expect more than 1,000 keys to be added in F '27
it's probably going to get pushed to F '28
So the room addition target doesn't change, number one.
Only probably 25% to 30% will be owned. The balance will come from capital-light models

red_flags.label: Impairment INR234 cr on Finland (HCRO) book
red_flags.quote: We took an impairment in our stand-alone books of about INR234 crores. This is obviously a one-off.

red_flags.label: Credit rejections high on new sales
red_flags.quote: there were some rejections, which were very high on some of the new sales

red_flags.label: Signature resort delayed to FY28
red_flags.quote: it's probably going to get pushed to F '28

evasions.quote: No, I think there is nothing to report today, Senthil.
